name: Cheese Filling for Peynirli Börek
author: Wikibooks Cookbook contributors
steps: Mix the feta into the cottage cheese by mashing together with a fork.
Add the beaten egg, chopped herbs and pepper, and stir until just mixed.
Place in a plastic covered container and refrigerate until ready to use.
See Börek recipe for further instructions.

culture.text: Börek, also referred to as burek or byrek, is a family of pastries or pies made in West Asia and Southeast Europe. The pastry is made of a thin flaky dough such as filo with a variety of fillings, such as meat, cheese, spinach, or potatoes. A borek may be prepared in a large pan and cut into portions after baking, or as individual pastries. They are usually baked but some varieties can be fried. Borek is sometimes sprinkled with sesame or nigella seeds, and it can be served hot or cold.
